scope: Installed PDF.js source inspection supports a hypothesis only; actual DOM selection failures remain authoritative. No reader modified.
hypothesis: RTL tokens are emitted in source word order, with backwards jumps between individually positioned tokens. The negative-advance branch resets pending whitespace and flushes text before the next token. This explains missing separators as a plausible mechanism; it is not evidence of a portable fix. Mark placement is a separate issue.
